items.title: SpaceX stock hits new closing low in rocky week ahead of earnings
items.summary: SpaceX stock whipsawed through a volatile week, swinging from an all-time low to a sharp rebound and closing at a new low, as investors braced for the newly public company's first earnings report and a major share unlock.

items.title: Tesla reportedly considering a spin off of its China business
items.summary: Tesla (TSLA) is reportedly considering a spin-off of its China business, according to the Wall Street Journal. This comes amid murmurs of a possible merger between the EV maker and Elon Musk's space venture SpaceX (SPCX).

items.title: Elon Musk Cools Off Tesla-SpaceX Merger Speculation as SpaceX Stock Hits Record Low
items.summary: The Wall Street Journal reports Tesla is considering selling its China business to facilitate a future merger with SpaceX.

items.title: Rivian Stock Reverses After Earnings. The R2 Rollout Is Paying Off.
items.summary: Thursday, the EV maker reported a second-quarter gross profit of $170 million. Wall Street was looking for $71 million.

items.title: Tesla Stock Falls 1.8% as Musk Denies China Separation Report
items.summary: Questions about Tesla's China operations resurfaced as domestic competitors expanded their market share and local sales weakened.

items.title: SpaceX Stock Has Plunged: Buy it Now?
items.summary: SpaceX is trading below its IPO price but there are questions about its future.

items.title: Short sellers pile into SpaceX ahead of earnings, lockup expiration
items.summary: Investing.com -- Short sellers have increased their positions in SpaceX before two major events next week: the company’s first earnings report as a public company and the release of hundreds of millions of locked-up shares.

items.title: SpaceX Is Now Down 36% in a Month. Would You Be Better Off With Rocket Lab or ASTS SpaceMobile?
items.summary: Space stocks are cratering across the board, and investors fleeing SpaceX for Rocket Lab or AST SpaceMobile may be walking straight into the same storm wearing a different jacket.
